intro: Register for the EAASI Partners Summit 2026 in Alicante. Tickets are purchased directly through the official EAASI website.
feesDeadlineNote: Early Bird pricing (Members/Observers and Non Members) is valid through August 31, 2026. Standard pricing applies from September 1, 2026.
notes: Please register early — it helps us with logistics and guarantees your place at the Summit.
Early Bird pricing ends August 31, 2026, so don't wait too long.
Not yet a member? You can apply to join EAASI at any time via the 'Apply' button on our homepage — membership comes with significant registration benefits.
We look forward to welcoming you in Alicante! 🌍
